content.name: Cloak of the Bat
entries: While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks. In an area of dim light or darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak with both hands and use it to fly at a speed of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in dim light or darkness, you lose this flying speed.

While wearing the cloak in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to cast {@spell polymorph} on yourself, transforming into a {@creature bat}. While you are in the form of the {@creature bat}, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

content.name: Cloak of the Bat
entries: While wearing this cloak, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|SRD52}) checks. In an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you lose this {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52}.

While wearing the cloak in an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can cast {@spell Polymorph|SRD52} on yourself, shape-shifting into a {@creature Bat|SRD52}. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
